mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market weakness that triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 9.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which suppress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 500.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market prompting aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output and potential supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate inflationary pressures and reduced corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as supply contraction, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
